## What

The figures on the start page were plain text; to act on "1 open signaal" you went to the Dagrapport and scrolled. Each label is now a link to the part it counts, on the same day:

- Fiches doorgegeven: the Dagrapport at "Nog niet doorgegeven"
- Ingevoerd in Bouwsoft: at "In te voeren in Bouwsoft"
- Voor de werfleider: at the signals
- Verteld, nog niemand die overneemt: Bespreken

The Dagrapport sections get ids (`niet-doorgegeven`, `in-te-voeren`, `signalen`) to land on.

## Checks

- 345 PHP tests and pint pass; HomeTest checks the three links and the anchor on the Dagrapport.
